reviews.text: This is a great movie and it really gives a nostalgic vibe of the early 2010's while also giving a great watching experience. While there is a lot of depiction of teenage banality, I still think that it is an extremely funny movie and one of my favourite comfort movies.

“Back in Queens…” I remember when this came out and suddenly everyone wanted to throw a Project X party. This genuinely left a mark on school and college culture in the 2010s. The found-footage style, the soundtrack, the complete fucking chaos and that feeling of FOMO. Few films take me back to that era quite like this one.

O filme funciona muito bem como found footage, adinâmica das câmeras funciona muito bem, além de ter um humor assertivo num ritmo bem rápido. Reassisti recentemente e, obviamente, não foi tão engraçado, mas eu já lembrava bem do filme. A dinâmica do Costa dando migué a todo momento, alinhada ao desconforto e à insegurança do Thomas, funciona para criar o clímax do filme, assim como as cenas de conflito com a polícia, que são uma das melhores demonstrações de rebeldia juvenil num filme, tudo isso atrelado a uma excelente escolha de músicas para compor a festa, que até hoje estão presentes em muitas playlists. Projeto X continua sendo um dos besteiróis mais relevantes, embora principalmente por ser o que é mais compatível com a geração Z.

Are the characters a little ordinary? Yes. However if you’re watching this expecting to study the characters and trying to understand their choices then what are you doing. This movie set out to make one of the greatest parties ever put to screen and it succeeded. Showing how the party went through distinct stages like it was its own living organism is such a cool thing to do. Great watch.

Not even joking…… I’m speechless Edit: ok now I can talk about it. Idk how I had never seen this. Why’s it have such mixed/low ratings? I decided to rent because it’s on every letterboxd list for “party movies” which is kind of one of the preferred genres (maybe to balance out life as a mom I need party movies?) idk but there’s something so perfect and masterful about how this is made, there’s a roughness to it that doesn’t feel overproduced, jokes are SO funny (was laughing the entire time), and extremely nostalgic. Very 2012 tumblr party era. God tier music. At first you’re like “oh this is just a Superbad copy” but then you’re like “oh Superbad wishes it was this” Kind of a perfect movie to put on when there’s people over. I think there’s so much art to it, and at one part my jaw was kind of on the floor of the level of insanity that builds to the end. Honestly? More insane and epic production than even the odyssey IM NOT KIDDING I want to show this to everyone (if you think it’s just some stupid party movie you just don’t GET IT????)

I’m probably incapable of being objective about this one, but no film captures the absolute worst of late-2000s high-school culture better than Project X . It takes the kind of house-party disaster that used to become national news and turns up the stupidity, damage and excess until it basically becomes a disaster movie . Everything about it is problematic, and almost none of it feels impossible. That soundtrack still turns up in clubs, and even the original screenings became improvised parties the second “ Pursuit of Happiness ” kicked in. I lived those nights, and I still get to relive them through this film. 🔥
